en: Dependent on a state that is associated with a root and is itself a root, there arises a state that is not associated with a root and is not a root, by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from a root and is itself a root, there arises a state that is dissociated from a root and is not a root, by way of the root condition … three.
(Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are six; under the object condition, three … pe … under the mutuality condition, four … pe … under the resultant condition.
Dependent on a state that is associated with a root but is not itself a root, there arises a state that is dissociated from a root and is not itself a root, by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Three for root, five for object, one for predominance ... [as above] ... conascence.

With respect to mutuality, five; ... [as before] ... with respect to prenascence and repetition, three; ... [as before] ... with respect to resultant, three; ... [as before] ... with respect to non-disappearance, five.
